recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not resurrect inactive Sequence source or back-port Sequence.referenceSeq wording into MolecularDefinition unless a new issue targets the current MolecularDefinition model.
issue_request: FHIR-11311 was a Published Clinical Genomics change request for DSTU2 Sequence.referenceSeq, resolved Persuasive, asking to replace the unclear definition with HGVS-style wording: a sequence file used as a reference to describe variants present in a sequence analyzed.
initial_application: Historical commit e6265cbcc05d58d02553c387ca007c9011b779d0 explicitly applied #11311 by changing source/sequence/sequence-spreadsheet.xml to the requested definition. No current active source containing the old definition was found.
additional_context: FHIR-19453 later renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence, and FHIR-51227 later replaced MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition. Current source/fhir.ini omits Sequence and MolecularSequence from active resources, lists Sequence under removed resources, comments out MolecularSequence metadata, and diagnostics narrative says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition. MolecularDefinition uses a different representation model and has no referenceSeq element to receive the old DSTU2 wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The seed was already applied to the legacy source, and the original target element is outside the current build; translating the historical HGVS wording into MolecularDefinition would require a new Clinical Genomics decision.

related_jiras.note: Published decision renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence, retiring the original resource name targeted by FHIR-11311.
